stories.headline: AFC backs UEFA and CONCACAF who plan boycott over FIFA World Cup proposals
stories.description: FIFA face global mutiny as Asian Football Confederation stand with Europe and North America after their boycott threats.

stories.headline: At least 11, including children, injured in Israeli raids near Nablus
stories.description: Israeli settlers and soldiers storm occupied West Bank towns, arrests made after intensified violence in town of Tal.

stories.headline: IRGC strikes US targets in Kuwait a day after US hits Iran: Latest events
stories.description: Iran says it struck Kuwait in retaliation for US strikes on multiple locations in Iran, including Qeshm island.

stories.headline: About 49,000 migrants enter Spanish enclave of Ceuta, officials say
stories.description: Thousands of migrants reportedly crossed illegally into the territory on Thursday and Friday.

stories.headline: Israeli forces blow up structures near Lebanon’s Beaufort Castle
stories.description: Israel claims army blew up Hezbollah tunnels in southern Lebanon, amid reports of blasts near UNESCO-listed fortress.
